notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for a successful ReleaseObjectInstanceName service report. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, standard MIM data elements, and the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, ordinary FOM, standard MIM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies the standard HLAreportServiceInvocation payload and name-reservation callback without provider-specific headers, registries, names, or diagnostics.
